title: Round 7 stream D: BELOW's chase camera never leaves ISAO's back (its yaw follows his heading at 6 /s, the wall shortens and lifts the boom on its own ray, the view looks along the camera's yaw) and the mouse does nothing
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, note 9 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-7-nine-notes-design.md, stream D): 'BELOW; the controls for ISAO are still wrong; both moving the mouse or A or D makes the cave flip around, none of that should be happening. ISAO is a quadcopter inside a cave. W tilts forward S tilts backward, A and D rotate for the next set of W and S. Space bar and shift for up and down.' Round 6's tilt and pitch-clamp fix was in below/ (0de7405), so this was a second cause. Branch round-7-below off 21eee83a; the cave in kai-denrei/stalheart-cave, branch round-7-below off round-6-below 0de7405, re-imported with scripts/import-below.mjs.
outcome: MEASURED FIRST (scratch r7-below/chase-probe.mjs, headless on the cave's own server under the lock; the base in a detached worktree of 0de7405): W 2 s, D 1.2 s, W 2 s at 60 steps/s from 16 places (the first maze corridor near its wall, the throat s 0.5/4, the elbow s 8/14/20, the maze s 45/60, on the axis and 3.5 m off it), per frame the camera-to-ISAO azimuth minus his yaw, the view's heading minus his yaw, the camera's up. BEFORE: the view swung 1.19 rad in ONE frame (24 frames over 0.15 rad across the runs), sat up to 1.71 rad off his heading (at his side or ahead) and looked down to up.y 0.27: the five-azimuth search (yaw +0, ±0.8, ±1.6) that took over whenever the wall cut the boom under 1.8 m; in the wide corridor's middle it never fired (0.02 rad steps), which is why it reads as 'the cave flips' only near walls and in the throat and elbow. A 400 px CDP mouse drag turned ISAO 0.8 rad and tilted the camera 0.16. AFTER (cave ace9566, below/ re-imported): the view's heading trails his by at most 0.206 rad (the follow lag of a 1.3 rad/s turn) and moves at most 0.020 rad a frame in every run; the boom's own azimuth where it reaches 1.2 m or more stays within 0.285 rad and 0.105 rad a frame; the up stays +Y (roll 0, up.y >= 0.47); the drag changes nothing (yaw, pitch, camera, no pointer lock). HOW: flight.js CHASE gains follow 6, boom 4.9, minBoom 1.2, rise 0.4 and two pure rules, chaseYaw(camYaw, heading, dt) (eased the short way, never past) and boomFor(clearance) ({ length, lift }); isao.js clips the risen boom along ISAO's own ray, eases its reach and height at rate 10 (the wall pulls it in at once, to the free point on the ray), hangs it from his position eased at rate 10, and looks along the camera's yaw down at his height over at least minBoom; a teleport (over 3 m in a step) re-seats it behind him. main.js loses the mousemove/mousedown/mouseup/pointerlockchange handlers, lock() and the exitPointerLock calls; the start card's line is 'W S FLY · A D TURN · SPACE SHIFT UP DOWN', the HUD line '↑ ↓ LOOK', the pause help and README say the mouse does nothing.
alternatives: The design's 'position lerp rate 10 stays' as a Cartesian lerp of the camera: overturned after the frames; a Cartesian lerp toward a shortened boom cuts a chord round ISAO (0.52 rad off at a pinned wall), so the reach and height ease in the camera yaw's half-plane and the point it hangs from (his position) eases at rate 10 instead.

camera.lookAt(ISAO) as before: overturned; when the rock pulls the boom in to centimetres over him (ISAO pinned against a wall with his back to it) a lookAt from above spins the view with every centimetre (0.66 rad in a frame, measured); the camera now looks along its own yaw, down at his height over at least minBoom, so the view's heading is the camera yaw in every frame.

confine() the risen camera point: rejected; it pushes toward the tunnel's axis, which in the throat and the elbow is round ISAO (1.75 rad off measured); the point is clipped along ISAO's own ray instead.
evidence: scratch r7-below: before-sweep.json / before2.json (base 0de7405), after6.json (final), chase-probe.mjs

cave test/flight.test.mjs: chaseYaw never steps over follow*dt of the gap, never past the heading, the short way across ±π, ~90% in 0.4 s; boomFor clamps to [minBoom, boom] with lift (boom - length) * rise; main.js holds no mouse or pointer-lock listener. Cave npm test 56/56, npm run check.
cave scripts/browser-test.mjs: the new step (four places, W/D/W, every frame: boom and view within 0.6 rad of his heading, no frame over 0.15, up +Y; a 400 px drag and move change nothing)
